title: Fix backend admin principal and force-set admin to uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae

requirements.text: In backend/main.mo, locate the admin principal storage (stable variable or hardcoded constant) and the isCallerAdmin function (or equivalent authorization check). Ensure the stored admin principal is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. The isCallerAdmin comparison must use caller.toText() and compare it directly against this string. If the admin principal is held in a stable variable, set its default/initial value to this principal so it is authoritative on upgrade.

quotes: Füge meine Principal explizit als Admin hinzu (im Code oder via Admin-Funktion)
Zeig mir die Motoko-Funktion isAdmin() / hasPermission / admin-check (Principal-Vergleich)

acceptanceCriteria: The backend stable variable (or hardcoded constant) for the admin principal is set to exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'
isCallerAdmin (or equivalent) returns true when called with principal uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae

The authorization check in addCollection (and any other admin-gated function) uses isCallerAdmin and no longer returns 'Keine Berechtigung: Nur Admins können Kollektionen verwalten.' for this principal

requirements.text: Create or update backend/migration.mo to overwrite the live canister's stored admin principal with 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' during the next canister upgrade, without losing any other stable state (collections, NFT items, user profiles, minted tokens).

quotes: Redeploy Live und teste Kollektion erstellen

acceptanceCriteria: migration.mo writes the correct admin principal to the stable admin variable on upgrade
All other stable state (collections, NFTs, user profiles) is preserved after upgrade
After redeployment to the live canister, isCallerAdmin returns true for principal uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae

requirements.text: In the frontend hook useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout, add or confirm a public query call to the backend's isCallerAdmin method (or equivalent) and log the raw result to the browser console. The console output must include: (1) the caller's principal text, (2) the hardcoded fallback principal, (3) the raw boolean result returned by the backend isCallerAdmin call, and (4) any error thrown. This is to allow immediate diagnosis if a mismatch persists on the live site.

quotes: Teste isAdmin-Call von Live aus – gib Result + Error
Vergleiche meine aktuelle Principal-ID mit der im Canister gespeicherten Admin-Liste

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the browser DevTools console on the live site shows the caller's principal, the hardcoded fallback, the backend isCallerAdmin result, and any error
The hook does not throw unhandled exceptions; errors are caught and logged
Admin status resolves correctly (true) for principal uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae after the backend fix is deployed

constraints: Do not lose any existing stable state (collections, NFT items, user profiles, minted tokens) during the canister upgrade
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
The admin principal must be exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' — no other value
nonGoals: Changing any NFT minting or collection display logic
Adding new backend endpoints beyond what is needed for admin authorization
